title: Read-only local preflight and operable checks

claims.text: report builds checks for home_permissions, registry, ledger, contract_conformance, references, ui_bundle and json_endpoints, and returns ok only when every check passed, together with unverified entries for scopes the preflight cannot certify.
_private_home requires the home to be an owned, group/other-free directory with no symlinked ancestor, and check_home skips dependent checks with an explicit unsafe-home failure when that gate fails.

contract_mismatches compares each registered tool input schema against the normative Arguments JSON blocks in docs/CONTRACT.md, and main returns 0 when healthy, 2 on bad tail arguments, and 3 on any failed check; operable_report runs the mechanical checklist against an owned temporary home only.

decision.rule: Change here when preflight checks, home safety gating, contract schema comparison, or the operable checklist needs to change.
decision.failure: Doctor passes despite a mismatched contract schema, or skips ledger checks silently for an unsafe home.

questions.q: Where does doctor compare registered schemas against docs/CONTRACT.md?
Where should I change which scopes doctor lists as unverified?
Where can I debug why home_permissions fails for an owned private home?
